summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin page is part of the HSPnet application, designed to facilitate staff administration tasks related to student employment applications. It includes controls for filtering and viewing applications, such as dropdowns for site and discipline selection, and a grid view displaying application data.
purpose: To manage and view student employment applications within an administrative context, including filtering by site, discipline, and date range.

workflows.name: Application Filtering
steps: Optionally, check chkShowWithdrawn to include withdrawn applications.

workflows.name: Data Initialization
steps: Set page labels and states based on user session.
Set default start and end dates.
Call RefreshData to load application data.

workflows.name: Validation
steps: Validate start and end dates using RegularExpressionValidator and CustomValidator.
Ensure end date is after start date with checkStartEnd JavaScript function.

business_rules: Default date range is set to the last three months.
All applications are shown unless filters are applied.
Withdrawn applications are shown only when chkShowWithdrawn is checked.
validations: Start date must be a valid date format.
End date must be a valid date format.
End date must be after start date.
conditions: If SiteID is provided in the query string, pre-select it in the ddSite dropdown.
system_behavior: On page load, set up the page according to the user's session data.
Use AJAX for asynchronous data refreshment in the UpdatePanel.
Page scripts are registered to include necessary JavaScript files.
exceptions: Display error messages in pnlError if any system errors occur.
Display warning messages in pnlWarning for non-critical issues.
